from pathlib import Path
import re

root = Path('servisler')
exclude = root / 'yedek'

# section = [veritabani] (harf duyarsız), port = ... satırı, yorum değil
section_re = re.compile(r'^\[\s*veritabani\s*\]', re.IGNORECASE)
port_re = re.compile(r'^\s*port\s*=\s*5432\s*$')

def change_file(path: Path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    # BOM varsa ayrı tut, aynen koru
    if raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'):
        bom = b'\xef\xbb\xbf'
        body = raw[len(bom):]
    else:
        bom = b''
        body = raw
    # satır sonu türünü tespit et (mixed line endings için splitlines(keepends))
    lines = body.splitlines(keepends=True)
    current_section = None
    changed = False
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        # satır sonu ayırıcıyı ayır
        if line.endswith('\r\n'):
            content, nl = line[:-2], '\r\n'
        elif line.endswith('\n'):
            content, nl = line[:-1], '\n'
        elif line.endswith('\r'):
            content, nl = line[:-1], '\r'
        else:
            content, nl = line, ''
        stripped = content.strip()
        if stripped.startswith('[') and stripped.endswith(']'):
            current_section = stripped[1:-1].strip()
        if section_re.match(stripped):
            current_section = 'veritabani'
        elif stripped.startswith('[') and stripped.endswith(']'):
            current_section = stripped[1:-1].strip()
        if current_section == 'veritabani' and port_re.match(content):
            # sadece değer kısmını değiştir, '=' etrafındaki boşlukları koru
            m = re.match(r'^(\s*port\s*=\s*)5432(\s*)$', content)
            if m:
                content = m.group(1) + '6543' + m.group(2)
                changed = True
        out.append(content + nl)
    if changed:
        path.write_bytes(bom + ''.join(out).encode('utf-8'))
    return changed

for ini in root.rglob('*.ini'):
    # exclude any path under servisler/yedek
    try:
        ini.relative_to(exclude)
        continue  # yedek klasörü atla
    except ValueError:
        pass
    changed = change_file(ini)
    print(f'{ini}: {"DEGISTI" if changed else "degisiklik yok"}')
